definitions.explanation: To put something (usually feelings) into something.
To put ammunition into a firearm.

examples.japanese: {心|こころ}を{込|こ}めて{作|つく}る。
examples.english: To make with heart and soul.
To put one's wishes into something.

notes:
{込|こ}める means to put into or include.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {心|こころ}を{込|こ}める: to put one's heart into
- {思|おも}いを{込|こ}める: to put one's feelings into
- {力|ちから}を{込|こ}める: to put effort into

RELATED:
- {込|こ}められた: filled with (passive)
